<function name="OnKeyCodeReleased" parent="PANEL" type="hook">
	<description>
Called whenever a keyboard key was released while the panel is focused.

<bug issue="2886">This is not run for TILDE/"toggleconsole" binding.</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="keyCode" type="number">The key code of the released key, see <page>Enums/KEY</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to suppress default action.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
